blind.table_distance_name: wall section with wallpaper and wainscoting
blind.description: A straight interior wall segment featuring decorative classical moulding. The lower third consists of pale beige/cream wainscoting with three raised rectangular panels and a baseboard. The middle section is surfaced with green damask patterned wallpaper showing vertical floral or palmette motifs. The top is capped with a protruding beige architectural cornice trim. The design is mirrored on both front and back faces, with flat solid sides.
blind.from_above: a simple elongated rectangle with a flat beige top surface
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 7 to 8 feet tall (noticeably taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
